notes.title: Update 1.1 Pussycat Feast!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/OJmJrGU.jpg

Who wants more Neko Girls??? In this update we present you with the delicious Pussycat Feast! Every single Neko Girl got a new color and a wet 4th Level. We also improved the UI in many places and corrected a lot of bugs. Between September 19th and 26th you can grab the game with 10% OFF or, even cheaper, if you get the CUMplete Pack with all the games from the Hentai Jigsaw Photo Studio series.

Until September 26th all Tabbu Entertainment Games are with great discounts. Check them below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968110/Neko_Girls_Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1812890/Fruit_Girls_2_Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1504460/Fruit_Girls_Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio/

Below is the complete changelog:

ART
We added 4 new artworks to each Neko Girl and 4 to the Pussycat Gang, totalizing 24 new artworks! You will unlock them by playing the Levels in the Photobook.

PUZZLE
To each new artwork, we have a new Level in the game! So, we have 24 new Levels in total! You can access them in the Photobook.
We removed the transparent effect used in the puzzle pieces.

PHOTOBOOK
We implemented the 24 Pussycat Feast Levels in the Photobook.
We also added cute cats in the Pussycat Feast pages of the Photobook.

DARKROOM
We implemented a Film Button to cycle through the artworks from the base game and the ones from the Pussycat Feast.

QUALITY OF LIFE
Now you can navigate in the Photobook and in the Darkroom using A or  to go Right.

ACHIEVEMENTS
We had to rework several Achievs to suit Steam's policies.
We also added the Achievs related to the new Puzzles but old owners will have almost all of them already unlocked due to how we implemented them.

THE HANDJOB ARTIFICER ART PACK
We added 37 artworks to the pack. It now contains 117 files!

Remember that our CUMplete Pack contains the new game, Neko Girls: HJPS, the new art pack Neko Girls: The Handjob Artificer Art Pack, the new soundtrack Neko Girls: The Horny Bard Soundtrack and everything from the second game, Fruit Girls 2: HJPS, and from the first game, Fruit Girls: HJPS. All of it with a permanent 20% discount that stacks with any sale discount!
